purpose: Governed exclusions from a target-resolved dependency closure. An exclusion is a REVIEWED, APPROVED, DATED, EVIDENCE-BOUND decision about one exact resolved package in one exact target — never a pattern, never a silent suppression.
policy_ownership: The required-field set, the supported schema versions and every rejection rule live in CODE (scripts/gate/lib/reconcile.mjs: EXCLUSION_REQUIRED_FIELDS, EXCLUSION_SCHEMA_VERSIONS, governExclusions). This document is DATA. The `required_fields` list below is a readable copy that the gate cross-checks against the code-owned set and REJECTS on any disagreement, so this file cannot weaken its own validation by editing itself.
semantic: A valid exclusion REMOVES the exact governed node, every edge incident to it, and every descendant the removal makes unreachable from the subject roots — each cascaded removal recorded individually. Reconciliation then runs against the reduced closure, which must contain no orphan and no dangling reference. Cascading is deterministic because reachability from a fixed root set is a function of the graph.

field_contract.id: Unique, stable identifier for this exclusion. Duplicated ids are rejected.
field_contract.scope: A scope the excluded node ACTUALLY holds in that target's closure, not merely one the target declares.
field_contract.resolution_key: Exact lockfile resolution key including any peer context. No wildcards, no name-only values.
field_contract.parent_edge: A real edge of that target's closure, in '<from> -> <to>' form, whose TO endpoint is the excluded component. An edge that terminates elsewhere does not justify this exclusion.
field_contract.reason: Why this exact resolution is excluded, in terms a reviewer can check.
field_contract.evidence: Repository-relative path to the supporting evidence. Must be tracked and exist.
field_contract.evidence_sha256: SHA-256 of that file's actual bytes. The gate recomputes it and rejects a mismatch, so the approval is bound to exact content.
field_contract.owner: The party responsible for the excluded dependency.
field_contract.approver: The party who approved the exclusion. MUST differ from owner.
field_contract.approved_on: ISO YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future.
field_contract.expires_on: ISO YYYY-MM-DD, strictly after approved_on and not in the past.

rejection_rules.wildcard_or_name_only: resolution_key containing '*' or '?', or lacking an exact version.
rejection_rules.duplicate_entry: Two entries excluding the same resolution_key from the same target, even if only one node would be removed — the applied cardinality would be ambiguous.
rejection_rules.stale_not_in_closure: resolution_key not resolved anywhere in pnpm-lock.yaml.
rejection_rules.unused_never_applied: resolution_key resolved by the lockfile but absent from the declared target's closure.
rejection_rules.version_changed: The package name is in the closure at a different version than the one reviewed.
rejection_rules.wrong_target: Unknown target, a scope the target does not declare, or a scope the node does not actually hold.
rejection_rules.wrong_parent: parent_edge is not a real edge, or does not terminate at the excluded component.
rejection_rules.future_approval: approved_on is after the run date.
rejection_rules.expired: expires_on is before the run date, or not after approved_on.
rejection_rules.unapproved: Malformed evidence_sha256, a non-ISO date, or approver identical to owner.
rejection_rules.untracked_or_missing_evidence: evidence is absolute, path-traversing, untracked, absent, or its digest does not match the recorded value.
rejection_rules.excludes_compatible_mandatory_dependency: A target-compatible MANDATORY (non-optional) dependency can never be excluded.

cardinality_contract: declared == valid + rejected; valid == applied; removed_nodes == applied + cascaded. Any disagreement fails the gate, because it means the applied set is not the governed set.
enforcement: scripts/gate/lib/reconcile.mjs governExclusions() + applyExclusions() + checkExclusionCardinality(). Every rule is driven by a control in apps/api/test/gate/c16-closure-controls.test.ts, including a positive fixture proving a valid exclusion is applied exactly once and the reduced closure still reconciles clean.
